ALWAYS CLOSE AT HAND

Your plants, in your pocket.

On iPhone

Open the published app in Safari. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open it once online and wait for “Ready offline” before relying on it without internet.

On Android

Open the published app in Chrome. Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

Adding a new plant

Tap Add a plant, enter its name, and use Search to open gardening results. Write a short care summary and save its source. Alternatively, ask your assistant to research it and create a Plant Pocket care file, then import that file here.

No accounts. No API keys.

The collection, photos and history are stored on this device. Search and source links use the internet only when you open them. There is no automatic photo identification, web scraping, cloud sync or background AI.

Keep a backup

Save a full backup regularly, especially before clearing browser data or changing phones. Each browser and home-screen installation may have its own storage. Import your backup on another device to transfer it. Backups contain your photos and notes.

Care reminders

Check today shows soil-check reminders when you open the app. It does not send push notifications while closed. You can download calendar reminders for a plant from its details; your phone calendar controls alerts.

Your home

Your radiators run infrequently and stay mildly warm; the plants have remained healthy there for three months. There’s no automatic “move plant” warning. Reassess if the pots heat up, drying speeds up, or heating use changes.

Season and watering

Automatic season uses Ireland’s April–September growing season and October–March cooler season. These are broad estimates; always use the compost check. You can override the season.
